column1: # Estimated share of Lightroom raw photographers by camera maker, and the popular bodies of the last ~8 years inside each.
# Sources (2026-10-10): Nikkei 2025 mirrorless production via PhotoRumors (Canon 2.3 M, Sony 1.8 M, Nikon 0.86 M, Fujifilm 0.75 M
# units, i.e. ~36 / 29 / 14 / 12 % of CIPA's 6.31 M); BCN 2025 Japanese retail via PetaPixel (Sony 29.9 %, Canon 27.4 %, Nikon 15.1 %);
# camera makers named in this repo's user issues (325 issues: Sony 33, Nikon 31, Canon 26, phones 23, Fujifilm 9, Panasonic/Leica 8,
# OM/Olympus 6, Pentax/Ricoh 6, Samsung NX 5). Canon and Nikon get extra weight for their installed base of DSLRs.
# Rows "maker" give the maker bucket's weight (percent of photographers); rows "body" give a popular body inside a bucket.
# Inside a bucket, the listed bodies share 80 % equally and every other Adobe-listed model of the bucket's makers shares 20 %.
